description_en:
Deletes an associated domain name from an edge container application. After deletion, the edge container service can no longer be accessed through this domain name.
Note: 1) You must first call CreateEdgeContainerApp to create an edge container application and record the returned AppId.
You must first call CreateEdgeContainerAppRecord to bind a domain name record (RecordName) to the application.
A complete three-step call example of create, bind, and delete is provided
description_zh:
删除某个边缘容器应用的关联域名，删除之后则无法再通过此域名访问到边缘容器服务。
说明：1) 须先调用 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建边缘容器应用并记录返回的 AppId；
须先调用 CreateEdgeContainerAppRecord 为该应用绑定域名记录（RecordName）；
提供完整的创建→绑定→删除三步调用示例
kebab_example: aliyun esa delete-edge-container-app-record --app-id app-880688675783790000 --record-name a.example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteEdgeContainerAppRecord

parameters.help_en: The site ID. This parameter is required. If it is not specified, the service returns InternalError(400). Call ListSites to obtain a valid SiteId before calling this operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID。此参数在实际调用中为必填项，缺少时服务将返回 InternalError(400)；请通过 ListSites 获取有效的 SiteId 后再调用本接口
parameters.name: site_id
